Product Details: WaveX Spray Wax for Car & Bike provides an unmatched depth of paint gloss, UV, paint and hard water spots protection. WaveX Spray Wax for Car & Bike is richly infused with ultra-refined carnauba wax and save you the time of application of traditional waxes. Its anti-static, non-dust attracting, streak-free formulation makes it safe and effective on painted surfaces, glass, chromes, headlight and windshields of cars. Acts as a standalone vehicle wax topper and as a booster for pre-existing wax dressings on cars and bikes. For best results, clean the vehicle with a WaveX Car Shampoo and spray it on wet or dried surface. Can be applied in direct sunlight or in a shaded area.
